package clean

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
)

func start(ctx context.Context, ch chan int) {
	go func() {
		select {
		case ch <- 1:
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		}
	}()
}

func child(parent context.Context) context.Context {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(parent)
	defer cancel()
	return ctx
}

func get() error {
	resp, err := http.Get("https://example.com")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	return nil
}

func query(db *sql.DB) error {
	rows, err := db.Query("select 1")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	return rows.Err()
}

func read() error {
	f, err := os.Open("input.txt")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	return nil
}

func encode(v any) ([]byte, error) {
	return json.Marshal(v)
}

func write(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB) error {
	tx, err := db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer tx.Rollback()
	return tx.Commit()
}

func run(input string) error {
	return exec.Command("go", "test", input).Run()
}

const tokenCount = 10
const passwordPolicy = "strict"
